commands.title: Generate library fonts, backgrounds, music, SFX and quality variants
commands.inputs: Selected library manifest, fonts/backgrounds/variants/music/sfx family, and authored sources.
commands.outputs: Accepted generated bundles and publication manifest.
commands.mutation: Stages and publishes requested content. --check validates without publication.
commands.build: No Cargo build. Each producer uses its separate Python environment.

commands.title: Preview font asset downloads
commands.inputs: Authored font download definitions and cache location.
commands.outputs: Download plan; explicit generation produces font files.
commands.mutation: --dry-run prints a plan without writing. Normal generation uses the publication owner.
commands.build: No Cargo build. Each producer uses its separate Python environment.
